themes.name: Web Slinger
themes.description: Midnight city, crimson glass and cobalt webs. Bold condensed headings, themed Veyra branding, angular control details, web timeline and an optional matching launcher icon.

themes.name: Halloween Nocturne
themes.description: Moonlit forest, pumpkin amber and gothic headings. Themed Veyra branding, sculpted controls, ember timeline and an optional matching launcher icon.

themes.name: Playtime Club
themes.description: An unofficial cartoon music party with Doraemon, Shin-chan and Oggy-inspired fan artwork. Rounded Fredoka headings, butter-yellow controls, mint bubbles, soft press feedback and a matching optional Veyra icon.

themes.name: Astral Tide
themes.description: Bioluminescent manta rays beneath a midnight ocean. Bold Space Grotesk headings, sea-glass mint controls, champagne starlight, custom waveform glyphs and an optional matching Veyra icon.

themes.name: Midnight Express
themes.description: Rainy night-train windows, warm amber light and coal-blue surfaces. Bold Rajdhani timetable-style headings, custom controls, a parallel route timeline and an optional ticket-waveform Veyra icon.

themes.name: Pumpkin Purr
themes.description: Cream ghost kittens, pumpkin lanterns and cocoa paper. Rounded Fredoka headings, soft corners, bubble timeline and an optional amber Glass Noir waveform icon.

themes.name: Sunset Crew
themes.description: Coastal violet coupes and honey sunset. Unofficial SpongeBob / Patrick fan art; characters belong to Nickelodeon / Paramount, no affiliation. Bold Rajdhani headings, road timeline and an optional violet-and-honey Glass Noir icon.

themes.name: Starry Spirits
themes.description: Gentle sheet ghosts under an original swirling teal-and-gold oil-painted sky. Space Grotesk headings, starlit timeline and an optional teal-and-gold Glass Noir icon.

themes.name: Analog Reverie
themes.description: Warm walnut, smoked olive, vinyl and a luminous swallow. Bold Manrope typography, restrained player details and an optional champagne Glass Noir waveform icon.

themes.name: Petal Promise
themes.description: Ivory stationery, dusky pink tulips, satin bows and watercolor hearts. Ivory artwork over readable plum-rose controls, rounded Fredoka headings and an optional rose Glass Noir waveform icon.

themes.name: Moonlit Herbarium
themes.description: Lavender wildflowers, ivory moths, a crescent moon and a small garden spirit. Space Grotesk headings, gold accents and an optional moonflower-waveform icon.

themes.name: Golden Afterglow
themes.description: Cinematic amber meadow and dusk silhouettes. Bold Manrope, bronze-and-olive controls, meadow navigation glyphs and an optional sunset-glass Veyra icon.

themes.name: Lilypond Parade
themes.description: Original pond pals and impressionist lily pads. Fredoka headings, jade surfaces, bubble timeline, lily navigation glyphs and an optional bunny-charm glass Veyra icon.

themes.name: Dustbyte Outpost
themes.description: Pixel-art desert cabin, mauve mesas and copper dusk. Bold Rajdhani, stepped navigation glyphs, route timeline and an optional miniature desert-diorama Veyra icon.

themes.name: Alpine Ember
themes.description: Pixel-art mountain cabin, mirrored lake and rose-gold dawn. Space Grotesk headings, pine-and-slate controls, mountain navigation glyphs and an optional alpine glass Veyra icon.

themes.name: Starfall Pals
themes.description: Original moon-bunny friends under painterly shooting stars. Fredoka headings, ink-blue glass, peach starlight, star-navigation glyphs and an optional celestial bunny-glass Veyra icon.

themes.name: Chrome Vesper
themes.description: Chrome cruciform filigree, black velvet and garnet light. Gothic headings, cathedral navigation glyphs, faceted transport and an optional silver-chain Glass Noir icon.

themes.name: Window Wish
themes.description: A moonlit walnut window, clover and original golden chick friends. Fredoka headings, moss-and-cream controls, window navigation glyphs and an optional crescent-window Glass Noir icon.

themes.name: Cassette Corner
themes.description: An original calico record-shop cat, mint fluorescent light and coral cassette shelves. Bold Rajdhani, tape-deck controls, record navigation glyphs and an optional miniature cassette Glass Noir icon.

themes.name: Azure Bloom
themes.description: Luminous blue blossom canopy, pink wildflowers and golden fireflies. Space Grotesk headings, moonstone controls, blossom navigation glyphs and an optional tree-under-glass Veyra icon.

themes.name: Strawberry Daydream
themes.description: Pastel cut-paper cat and bunny friends, strawberries and ivory daisies. Fredoka headings, readable plum controls, heart-and-petal glyphs and an optional strawberry-charm Glass Noir icon.
